data.name: H2My Park Game
data.detailed_description:
H2My Park Game - A structure-, simulation- and strategy game with the production of solar energy and hydrogen.

Do you want to experience the energy transition firsthand?
Then H2My-Park is your game and challenge!

(Early-Access)

Build modern energy parks, supply and trade with cities and industrial facilities.**
Develop the perfect strategy to make your energy park productive.
Strategic thinking and the correct placement of modules will keep the energy flowing.


Become the best in every stage of developing your energy park strategy.
Only you can influence the future; only you decide how high the energy output will be!
Many modules for energy generation are at your disposal.


Each mission is full of strategic content and calculations for a new H2 farm (energy park).
Technological progress is an important component of your tactics.


Build energy parks and use new technologies that feel realistic and represent energy generation processes.
Ready for the energy strategy of the future?
Build your energy park and embark on a journey into a possible future!


Download H2My Park Game today!


The game has the following features:


★ Energy modules with real-time production and consumption
★ Traffic and vehicle AI
★ Day and night times
★ Various weather conditions
★ Various regions
★ Supply cities
★ High score - mission timing

We will expand and update the game with the following features:

★ **Supply of industrial facilities, means of transport, and rocket stations (space travel)
★ Manual city building (construction)
★ City AI: Buildings in the city build themselves when enough energy is available
★ Gameplay with sabotage attacks - defensive measures.
★ E-methane/E-fuel (H₂ & CO₂) production
★ Representation of industrial facilities: steel construction, district heating, and CO₂ production
★ 2-3 assembly vehicles

 


Features:

★ 5 game modes - easy, normal, and hard (1-5 stars)
★ Use new technologies! Science is the key to faster progress.
★ Explore new areas, pay attention to the weather, sun, and wind!
★ Trade with the city in your area,
★ Original and unique development options,
★ Choose your own way to make your energy park flourish,
★ Build modern energy structures,
★ Fantastic atmosphere in global worlds,
★ Impressive scale,
★ Freedom to choose all energy modules,
★ Stylized, stunning low-poly graphics,
★ Civilization game,
★ Master technologies, explore the landscapes, build an energy park,
★ Turn-based strategy game,
★ Impressive graphics and addictive gameplay,


The energy supply of the cities and industrial facilities is entirely in your hands!

There are currently 8 missions in the game.
The game will be released in summer 2025 for desktop and Android (smartphone and tablet). (Steam and Google Play Store)
An additional 18 missions for summer/fall/winter 2025.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD FX / Core i3 2G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX / AMD Radeon RX
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard-Soundchip
